    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">.NET如何实现向量语义分析</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br">一、概述</h2>
<p><img alt="图片" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/192878/202605/192878-20260518223443904-121628497.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="图片" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/192878/202605/192878-20260518223540972-2001296223.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 这段时间一直在做插件平台，组件插件化，还有AI Agent组件插件，还扩展支持ai 知识库，向量语义分析，还研究了语言大模型、向量大模型，还有什么归一化，点积，余弦相似度等语义算法分析匹配，之前一直用llamasharp，然后用LLamaEmbedder 做向量语义分析，但是发现匹配不准确。后面查资料LLamaEmbedder 做中文短文本语义向量，本来就不准，尤其是：现在几点 / 当前时间 / 几点了 / 查时间生成模块代码 / 数据库表结构<br>它不准是天生缺陷。</p>
<h2>二、LLamaEmbedder 为什么不准？（核心原因）&nbsp; &nbsp;</h2>
<p> 它是 LLM 大语言模型，不是向量模型，不是专门为语义向量训练的，向量质量远不如 Sentence-BERT、BGE、m3e 这类专业模型。<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; 中文支持极差LlamaEmbedder 原生对中文短文本、口语化问句几乎不优化。<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; 输出的向量没有归一化、没有对齐语义导致余弦相似度乱跳：<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 同义句分数低<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 无关句分数高<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; 速度慢、占用高对比专业向量模型，完全不适合做匹配。<br><br></p>
<h2>二、.net 真正准的语义向量方案（中文最强）</h2>
<p>有两种向量模型方案：<br>方案 1：BGE 向量模型（国内最准）<br>方案 2：m3e 向量模型（轻量、超快、中文专门训练）</p>
<h2>三、如何使用BGE 向量模型做向量语义分析</h2>
<p><strong>&nbsp;下载这个：bge-small-zh 中文向量模型</strong></p>
<p><a href="https://hf-mirror.com/Xenova/bge-small-zh-v1.5" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://hf-mirror.com/Xenova/bge-small-zh-v1.5</a></p>
<p><strong>或单独下载<code>vocab.txt，<code>model.onnx</code></code></strong></p>
<p><a href="https://hf-mirror.com/Xenova/bge-small-zh-v1.5/resolve/main/vocab.txt" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><code>https://hf-mirror.com/Xenova/bge-small-zh-v1.5/resolve/main/vocab.txt</code></a></p>
<p><a href="https://hf-mirror.com/Xenova/bge-small-zh-v1.5/resolve/main/onnx/model.onnx" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><code>https://hf-mirror.com/Xenova/bge-small-zh-v1.5/resolve/main/onnx/model.onnx</code></a></p>
<p>然后可以封装成以下代码：需要通过nuget引用下载Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime和Microsoft.ML.Tokenizers</p>
<p class="header-iWP5WJ auto-hide-last-sibling-br"><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnnxBgeEmbeddingService : IDisposable
  {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InferenceSession _session;
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> BertTokenizer _tokenizer; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用 BertTokenizer

      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模型输入名称（动态获取或硬编码）</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _inputNameIds;
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _inputNameMask;
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> _inputNameTokenType; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 新增：token_type_ids 名称</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _outputName;

      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> BGE 模型配置</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> MaxLength = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">512</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> PadTokenId = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> TokenTypeId = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> BGE/BERT 单句输入通常全为 0</span>

      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> OnnxBgeEmbeddingService(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> modelPath, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> vocabPath)
      {
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 初始化 ONNX 会话</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> sessionOptions = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SessionOptions();
          sessionOptions.InterOpNumThreads </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
          sessionOptions.IntraOpNumThreads </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

          _session </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InferenceSession(modelPath, sessionOptions);

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 初始化分词器</span>
          _tokenizer =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BertTokenizer.Create(vocabPath);

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 获取模型输入输出名称</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> inputKeys =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _session.InputMetadata.Keys.ToList();
          _inputNameIds </span>= inputKeys.FirstOrDefault(k =&gt; k.Contains(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input_ids</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)) ?? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input_ids</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
          _inputNameMask </span>= inputKeys.FirstOrDefault(k =&gt; k.Contains(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">attention_mask</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)) ?? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">attention_mask</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 关键修复：查找 token_type_ids 或 token_type_ids 类似的键</span>
          _inputNameTokenType = inputKeys.FirstOrDefault(k =&gt; k.Contains(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">token_type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)) ?? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">token_type_ids</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_session.OutputMetadata.Count == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Model has no outputs.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
          _outputName </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _session.OutputMetadata.Keys.First();
      }

      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span>[] GenerateEmbedding(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> text)
      {
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ArgumentException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Text cannot be null or empty</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 分词并预处理 (截断 + 填充)</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> (inputIds, attentionMask, tokenTypeIds) =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EncodeAndPreprocess(text);

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 构建输入张量
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注意：大多数 BGE ONNX 模型接受 int64 (long)，部分优化模型接受 int32 (int)
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果报错 Type Mismatch，请将 DenseTensor&lt;long&gt; 改为 DenseTensor&lt;int&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> inputIdsTensor = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> DenseTensor&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>&gt;(inputIds, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, inputIds.Length });
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> attentionMaskTensor = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> DenseTensor&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>&gt;(attentionMask, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, attentionMask.Length });
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> tokenTypeIdsTensor = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> DenseTensor&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>&gt;(tokenTypeIds, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, tokenTypeIds.Length });

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> inputs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;NamedOnnxValue&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      {
          NamedOnnxValue.CreateFromTensor(_inputNameIds, inputIdsTensor),
          NamedOnnxValue.CreateFromTensor(_inputNameMask, attentionMaskTensor),
          NamedOnnxValue.CreateFromTensor(_inputNameTokenType, tokenTypeIdsTensor) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 关键修复：添加此输入</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      };

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 执行推理</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> results =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _session.Run(inputs);

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 提取结果</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> rawOutput = results.First().AsTensor&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 关键修复：正确获取维度
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> rawOutput 形状通常为 [1, seq_len, hidden_size]
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Dimensions 是一个 int[] 数组，例如 [1, 512, 384]</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (rawOutput.Rank != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Expected 3D output, got {rawOutput.Rank}D</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> seqLen = rawOutput.Dimensions.Length; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 序列长度</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> hiddenSize = rawOutput.Dimensions.Length; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 向量维度</span>

          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span>[] embedding = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[hiddenSize];

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 平均池化 (Mean Pooling)</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> validTokenCount = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; seqLen; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
          {
              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 只有当 attention mask 为 1 时才参与计算</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (attentionMask[i] == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
              {
                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> j = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; j &lt; hiddenSize; j++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                  {
                      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 累加每个维度的值</span>
                      embedding[j] += rawOutput[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, i, j];
                  }
                  validTokenCount</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
              }
          }

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 求平均</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (validTokenCount &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
          {
              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; hiddenSize; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
              {
                  embedding[i] </span>/=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> validTokenCount;
              }
          }

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6. L2 归一化</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">          Normalize(embedding);

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> embedding;
      }

      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 编码并预处理：截断、填充、生成 Mask 和 Token Type IDs
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>[] InputIds, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>[] AttentionMask, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>[] TokenTypeIds) EncodeAndPreprocess(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> text)
      {
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用 BertTokenizer 编码
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> EncodeToIds 返回 ReadOnlyMemory&lt;int&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>[] originalIds =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _tokenizer.EncodeToIds(text).ToArray();

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> currentLen =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> originalIds.Length;

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 截断 (Truncation)</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (currentLen &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MaxLength)
          {
              Array.Resize(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> originalIds, MaxLength);
              currentLen </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MaxLength;
          }

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 填充 (Padding)</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (currentLen &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MaxLength)
          {
              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> oldLen =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> originalIds.Length;
              Array.Resize(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> originalIds, MaxLength);
              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将新增部分填充为 PadTokenId (0)</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = oldLen; i &lt; MaxLength; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
              {
                  originalIds[i] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PadTokenId;
              }
          }

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 生成 Attention Mask 和 Token Type IDs</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>[] attentionMask = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[MaxLength];
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>[] tokenTypeIds = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[MaxLength];

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; MaxLength; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
          {
              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Mask: 非 Padding 位为 1，Padding 位为 0</span>
              attentionMask[i] = (originalIds[i] != PadTokenId) ? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> : <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Token Type IDs: BGE 单句任务通常全为 0</span>
              tokenTypeIds[i] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TokenTypeId;
          }

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将 int[] 转换为 long[] 以匹配 ONNX 输入要求</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span>[] finalInputIds = Array.ConvertAll(originalIds, x =&gt; (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)x);

          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (finalInputIds, attentionMask, tokenTypeIds);
      }

      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> Normalize(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] vector)
      {
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> sum = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> v <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> vector)
          {
              sum </span>+= v *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> v;
          }
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> norm = (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)Math.Sqrt(sum);
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (norm &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
          {
              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; vector.Length; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
              {
                  vector[i] </span>/=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> norm;
              }
          }
      }

      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Dispose()
      {
          _session</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Dispose(); 
      }
  }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>以下是调用：</p>

<pre> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> onnxBgeEmbeddingService = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OnnxBgeEmbeddingService(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Models/model.onnx</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Models/vocab.txt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
 onnxBgeEmbeddingService .GenerateEmbedding(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">微服务是什么</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
